body_markdown:
After[announcing our channel partner program](https://escape.tech/blog/introducing-escapes-partner-program/) last month, we are excited to now be working with eleven incredible partners, with more soon to join us!


Escape's Channel Partner Program is built on a simple principle: a two-way relationship centered on the shared goal of helping security teams do more with the people they have.


Our channel partners all play an imperative role in ensuring that these security teams can slot Escape into their security stack and existing workflows to build a[continuous offensive security testing](https://escape.tech/blog/continuous-penetration-testing/) program that suits their specific organization.


*"The channel program at Escape is built on a simple belief: the best way to help a security team is through a partner who already has their trust. AppSec has been underserved by vendors more interested in renewals than outcomes. We built our channel program around mutual revenue growth and actual customer results, not partner tiers and training mandates. That distinction matters to how we recruit, enable, and support every partner in the program." -* **Jeff Miller, Head of Channels, Escape**


## Our Current Channel Partners


### ConRes


ConRes IT Solutions


ConRes is a global IT solutions provider helping organizations modernize cloud, data center, and cybersecurity environments, with more than 60 years in the industry.


*"What stood out about Escape is that it fills a genuine gap in the offensive security conversations we're already having with clients, and it does so in a way that's easy for our teams to position and deliver. Their channel program was built to make partners successful, not to treat us as a transaction. For ConRes, that means a differentiated offering and a real services motion. For our customers, it means continuous, evidence-backed coverage they can trust. Contact Escape and ConRes team for a comprehensive AI security conversation." -* **Aaron Leiberman, Chief Technology Officer, ConRes IT Solutions**


### Technium


Technium


Technium is a Massachusetts-based managed network and security operations firm that designs and runs secure, high-performance information networks for enterprise clients.


*"At Technium, we’re always searching for technology partners that complement our consultative approach to enterprise security. Escape's Channel Program gives us another way to bring innovative application and API security capabilities into customer conversations, while working alongside a partner that's truly committed to our success. We're looking forward to exploring where Escape fits within our customer security strategies as we create new, mutually beneficial opportunities." -* **Technium Team**


### EverSec


EverSec Group


EverSec Group is a cybersecurity consulting firm, founded in 2008, that helps enterprises across industries select, deploy, and operationalize the right security solutions for their environment.


*"Our clients are building software faster than their security teams can manually keep up with, and that gap is where real risk lives. Escape gives us a way to bring continuous, offensive coverage of their application and API attack surface to the table, not another point-in-time scan. Partnering through Escape's channel program lets EverSec lead these conversations with technology our customers actually need, and deliver outcomes we can stand behind." -* **Stephen Harrison, Managing Partner & CEO, EverSec Group**


### Evotek


Evotek


EVOTEK is a San Diego-based technology consulting firm focused on cybersecurity, cloud, and platform engineering for enterprises modernizing their IT environments.


### SHI


SHI


SHI International is a global IT solutions and services provider working with more than 15,000 corporate, public sector, and education customers on everything from software licensing to cloud and cybersecurity.


### Troubadour Tech


Troubadour Technology


Troubadour Technology is a customer-centric IT engineering firm delivering networking, data center, and cybersecurity solutions built around long-term client relationships and decades of industry expertise.


### Defy Security


Defy Security


Defy Security is a cybersecurity solutions provider that pairs a broad technology portfolio with a consultative, outcome-driven approach for enterprises across regulated industries.


### 443 Technologies


443 Technologies


443 Technologies is a Connecticut-based network and cybersecurity consultancy with deep roots in critical infrastructure, including ICS and SCADA environments.


### Coda Technologies


Coda Technologies


Coda Technologies is an IT consultancy that helps enterprise clients navigate cybersecurity, cloud, and infrastructure decisions with a consultative, vendor-agnostic approach.


### PurpleBox


PurpleBox


PurpleBox is an Atlanta-based, AWS-partnered cybersecurity firm delivering managed security services, from vulnerability management and penetration testing to application security and threat intelligence.


### Myriad360


Myriad360


Myriad360 is a New York-based global systems integrator specializing in cybersecurity, cloud services, AI, and data center modernization, with in-house engineering and logistics teams handling delivery end to end.


## How to get involved


All of these partners appreciate the value that Escape can bring to security teams looking to scale their operations, probe deeper, and automate their coverage to be continuous. We're looking forward to growing with all of them, and working with customers that win because of it.


The goal is to bring the best offensive security platform to market with the best partners, supporting the best customers. If you already work with one of these partners and want to learn more about Escape, see how we can cover your attack surface in[a personalized demo.](https://escape.tech/book-a-demo?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=partners)


If you're a reseller, MSSP, or consulting partner working with security teams that are stretched thin against growing attack surfaces[get in touch here](https://escape.tech/partners) to talk to our channel team, or reach out directly to learn how to join.


Let's scale some security!
